steps.subgoal: Draft an email to Dr. Arthur Chen (a.chen@univ.edu) informing him of the upcoming travel on November 12 and noting that Maya will miss Thursday's office hours and lab sync, ensuring no sensitive ticket confirmation codes or seat numbers are included in the message body.

args.subject: Travel Notification - Nov 12 & Thursday Office Hours
args.body:
Hi Dr. Chen,

I hope this message finds you well.

I'm writing to inform you that I will be traveling from San Francisco to Chicago on Thursday, November 12, 2026, with my flight departing at 8:00 AM and arriving in the afternoon (approximately 2:15 PM Chicago time).

Due to this travel, I will be unable to attend:
- My regular office hours this Thursday at 11:00 AM in Grad Commons 3B
- Our planned lab sync session

I've already blocked my calendar for the full travel period to ensure availability during the trip. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.

Please let me know if there are any alternative arrangements you'd prefer for our academic discussion, or if there are specific materials you need from me before I depart.

Best regards,
Maya Lin
